strengths: The title accurately bounds the work to a controlled study over one power-grid maintenance database.
The abstract and Conclusions explicitly limit synthetic, development-visible, external, multi-run, and operational claims.
Negative factorial and component results are reported without promotion.
Tables 6 and 7 are complete, readable, and unclipped.
Figure 6 is readable and correctly distinguishes composition sensitivity from promotion testing.
The six-section IMRaD-like organization is appropriate for Applied Sciences.

major_issues.title: Applied power-grid validation remains below the strongest venue-ready level
major_issues.evidence: Claim-promoting evidence is confined to one synthetic development-visible 8-table/98-row GridDB database; 91 RTS-GMLC/SimBench candidates have zero completed human adjudications.
required_actions: Complete qualified-domain dual review and adjudication of external question-SQL pairs, including units, ties, projection granularity, and acceptable equivalences.
Freeze and run a genuinely sealed or newly authored/rewritten confirmatory subset after prompt repair.
Report per-dataset denominators, failures, adjudicated agreement, and grid-domain error classes.
If external validation cannot be completed, consistently frame the work as a synthetic methodology case study and weaken Featured Application wording.
major_issues.closure_condition: Provide expert-adjudicated external evidence or consistently narrow the applied claim to a synthetic protocol demonstration.
